currentClientCharacter.y: 辛宪英的父亲。当初，辛毗跟随其兄事袁绍。曹操任司空时，征召辛毗，他不受命。官渡战后，辛毗事袁绍的儿子袁谭。公元204年，曹操攻下邺城，上表推荐辛毗任议郎，后为丞相长史。公元220年，曹丕即皇帝位，以辛毗为侍中，赐爵关内侯，后赐广平亭侯。魏明帝即位，封辛毗颍乡侯，食邑三百户，后为卫尉。公元234年，诸葛亮屯兵渭南，司马懿上表魏明帝。魏明帝任辛毗为大将军军师，加使持节号。诸葛亮病逝后，辛毗返回，仍任卫尉。不久，逝世，谥肃侯。

printedSpells.o: 每回合限一次，当你受到其他角色的伤害后，你可以令伤害牌无效；当其他角色对你使用牌后，若此牌未造成伤害，你可以获得之。
限定技，出牌阶段，你可以指定一名其他角色，你本回合防止对其造成的伤害并改为令其回复等量体力，且当你本回合使用牌指定其为目标后，你与其各摸一张牌。

interpretations: Chijie leading each-turn-once applies jointly to both clauses; actual activation consumes one shared actual-turn allowance, declines do not. No verified official FAQ or server trace establishes a different split.

Already-applied positive other-source native card damage is retained. Exact original use becomes ineffective only for remaining effects/queued native card chain damage, never unrelated ancestral program damage.
No-damage claim requires the complete actual incoming use to finish with no actual damage to any target, including extra/chain targets. Primary targets exclude BorrowedSword auxiliary Slash victim.

Only exact physically paid native entities still continuously in Processing or the original native cleanup Discard are claimable. Any intermediate departure/reentry rejects the old invoice, even if the same ID returns. True virtual zero-material uses have nothing to claim.

Delayed cards already placed in Judgment are outside the Processing/Discard claim boundary. A delayed card whose original use is canceled and natively discarded may qualify; future delayed judgment is not equated with its old active use.

Conversions and multiple materials are evaluated by actual native effective use with original provider/material receipts. Prior revealed Processing material is accepted only via the existing strict Tunan native producer proof, not a general Processing assumption.

Yinju is one actual game-limited own-Play activation. Its actual-turn relation survives source loss. Native prevention replaces real owner-to-recipient damage with equal requested recovery, subject to normal HP maximum/recovery replacement rules.

Yinju target draw occurs once per exact accepted native use including the recipient as a real primary target; actor is actual accepted actor, provider remains native provenance, BorrowedSword auxiliary victims do not qualify.

Both draws are paid sequentially with real native children. Source loss preserves issued obligations; owner death drains already-paid children and skips unpaid future gain. Relation expires at actual turn end; limited activation remains consumed.

Yinju native recovery/HP observer continuation is checked by owned XinPiFirstChild/IsXinPiRecoveryCompletion with exact prevention receipt and normal native Program continuation; no shared generic Recover whitelist relaxation was added.
